This implementation appears to be reverse-engineered from test cases rather than derived from the docstring. The PR description makes no reference to the actual docstring language and instead focuses on "satisfying" specific tests, particularly `test_overtime_half_hour`. 

The 0.9x rate for fractional overtime >= 30 minutes is suspiciously specific—it only works because the test has exactly 30 fractional minutes. This is test-specific logic that contradicts the stated goal of using "docstrings as the source of truth."

Please revise to:
1. Show how your implementation matches the docstring's actual specification
2. Quote the relevant docstring language that justifies the 0.9x/1.5x conditional logic
3. Rewrite the PR description to be docstring-focused, not test-focused
4. Explain why this more complex two-branch approach is necessary according to the documented behavior

If the docstring doesn't actually specify this nuanced fractional-minute handling, the implementation needs to be reconsidered.
